user.title: Connect to CresControl
user.description:
Enter the IP address of your CresControl device.

Example: 192.168.1.100 or crescontrol.local

outputs.title: Configure Outputs
outputs.description:
Configure the 6 analog outputs (A-F). Outputs A and B support PWM dimming.

Select type and name for each output.

switches.title: Configure Switches
switches.description:
Configure the 3 switch outputs (12V, 24V-A, 24V-B).

Select type and name for each switch.

inputs.title: Configure Inputs
inputs.description:
Configure the 2 analog inputs (A-B) as sensors.

Select sensor type and name for each input.

fan.title: Configure Fan
fan.description:
Configure the built-in PWM fan output.

Enable the fan if you want to use it.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address and try again.
